sources.entry: Sangeet - A beautiful audiophile music player with 10-band EQ, karaoke mode, and time-synced lyrics. ![Open-Source Software][oss icon] ![Freeware][freeware icon]

summary.one_liner: Sangeet is an offline-first, native macOS music player built on the BASS audio engine, with a SwiftUI interface, bit-perfect output, and synced karaoke-style lyrics.
summary.what_it_does: Sangeet plays audio from local folders on macOS, reading tags and artwork directly from files without importing or copying them. Its audio engine uses Un4seen BASS and offers bit-perfect output that bypasses the system mixer, optional exclusive device access (Hog Mode), and automatic sample rate switching up to 192kHz/32-bit. Playback features include gapless transitions, a crossfade, and ReplayGain volume normalization. The README also describes an 8-band parametric EQ, a Cmd+K global search, and a "Radio"/infinite queue that picks similar tracks from the local library using an on-device taste profile. Lyrics can come from local .lrc, .txt, or embedded tags, or be fetched online (LyricsPlus, with LRCLib fallback) and cached on disk for a full-screen karaoke overlay. Play counts, favorites, and history are stored in a local SQLite database via GRDB.swift.
use_cases: play local music files on a Mac with high-fidelity output
use a Mac music player offline without an account
show time-synced or word-synced lyrics while listening
karaoke-style lyric display for personal listening
browse a local music library by artist, album, or track
auto-generate a queue of similar songs from my own library
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (the README leaves the URL blank)
Ensure libbass.dylib is in Data/Audio/BASS/ (included in repo)
Press Cmd+R in Xcode to build and run
stack: Un4seen BASS audio library (C++ bridged to Swift)
notable: Bit-perfect output with optional exclusive device access (Hog Mode) and native sample rate switching
Offline-first design: only lyrics fetching uses the network, and fetched lyrics are cached locally
Local .lrc sidecar files with enhanced word timing take priority over online lyrics
Folder-based library that reads files in place with no import step
Local taste-profile Radio and infinite queue built from your own library
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later and Xcode to build from source
Online lyrics fetching requires internet; other playback works offline
The README gives no explicit license, and the clone URL is left blank in the install steps
keywords: play local mp3 flac on mac
